notes.title: V.1.1.6 Update : QoL Improvements and Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Everyone![/b]

A new update has just been released for Decline's Drops! At first, I planned to wait for the next major content update before releasing a new patch, but some bugs were reported that required immediate attention, mainly:  
[b]
1. Custom commands were not properly configured and could trap the player in the options menu.  
2. An item (the Shiny Shiny Phial) in Serge's shop could not be unlocked, preventing players from achieving 100% completion.  [/b]

These frustrating bugs have now been fixed, so you should be able to enjoy the game as intended without any issues! Game performance has also been improved, especially in Time Trial mode.  

In any case, here is the full Patch Notes:  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42973984/f5be8bd9e55bc783f5a086562c9e948479b855f3.png[/img]

As for the next major content update, progress is going well, although I can't provide a precise release date yet. Don't forget to join the game's Discord if you want to stay updated on upcoming updates!  

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42973984/04574bd9f924e985565eb8f287ebe63bab482f3b.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42973984/04574bd9f924e985565eb8f287ebe63bab482f3b.gif[/img][/url]

Thanks for reading, and see you soon!


[i]-Drazglb[/i]

notes.title: DECLINE'S DROPS: FIRST MAJOR UPDATE IS OUT
notes.content:
[h1]IT'S UPDATE TIME BOYS[/h1]

[b]The first major update of Decline's Drops is finally here! [/b]As promised, it brings [b]the Boss Rush Mode, Time-Attack[/b] with GHOSTS, your own but also the Dev Ghosts - that means those are my ghosts. That's me playing. I'm quite bad at my own game, you'll see. But if you beat all of them, you'll get a special reward, isn't that great? [i]Spoiler alert: it's another new Mode[/i]! There's also another bonus you get for beating the Boss Rush Mode, in fact, there are new bonuses everywhere! You'll also get two new objects available at Serge's Shop, unlockable once specific requirements are fulfilled, and also many quality of life improvements, bug fixes, new options, new buttons!
[b]I also made sure to include lots of new option regarding the smash attacks,[/b] so for example you can now disable the Smash attacks by pressing a direction and the normal attack button, or use the right stick to launch them. 
[b]In any case, please take a look at the full Patch Notes to see what's new![/b]

To celebrate and also as part of the Steam Winter Sales, [b]Decline's Drops is 30% off until January 2nd![/b]

It was a ton of fun making this new update and I hope you will enjoy the new content. But, as you probably now, this is not over yet, I still have a looot more to bring to the world of Decline's Drops, and [b]the next update will be quite big,[/b] so it will probably take more time to be done.

In the meantime, enjoy the new update, and please, [b]please leave a review if you haven't already[/b], it helps a ton!

Thank you so much for reading and playing Decline's Drops!
[i]
-Drazglb.[/i]

notes.title: IMPORTANT NOTES ABOUT STEAM CLOUD SUPPORT
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

Today I am very happy to announce you that[b] Decline's Drops now support Steam Cloud saving![/b] This has been asked multiple times and, as someone who plays/tests my own game multiple times both on PC and Steam Deck, this was quite required to say the least.

However, I've been forced to make a few changes in order to make this work. As a result, if you already play the game on two different platforms (like I do), [b]I recommend you follow the following steps:[/b]
[list]
[*] Go into your Local App Data and look for a folder named "D_D_21".
[*] Copy what's inside this folder and save it somewhere else, just in case.
[*] Uninstall/Reinstall Decline's Drops.
[*] Launch the game again.
[/list]

If everything works fine your files should be saved and loaded as intended. Note that these steps are just a recommendation . [b]If everything works fine without touching anything, well, don't change anything![/b]

That's it for now! I would also like to thank everyone who bought the game during the Steam Autumn Sales, I hope you'll enjoy what the game has to offer so far! Speaking of which, good news are coming, stay tuned, because[b] the next content update is coming very soon...![/b]

Thank you very much for reading!

[i]-Drazglb.[/i]
